categories.main_business_segments: Novoray Corporation (Jiangsu Lianrui New Materials Co., Ltd.) primarily engages in the research, manufacturing, and sales of inorganic non-metallic powder fillers and particulate carriers. Its product portfolio includes micron and submicron angular powders, spherical inorganic powders produced by flame fusion, high-temperature oxidation, and liquid phase methods, as well as surface-treated ultrafine particles and slurry products. These products serve advanced semiconductor packaging materials, electronic circuit substrates, thermal interface materials, adhesives, honeycomb ceramics, 3D printing, dental materials, and other emerging applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies including raw material design, particle design, composite doping, high-temperature spheroidization, particle dispersion, liquid phase synthesis, combustion synthesis, crystal phase control, surface modification, and simulation modeling. Manufacturing methods involve advanced grinding, flame fusion, high-temperature oxidation, and liquid phase processes to produce high-purity, spherical micron and submicron powders with tailored particle size, morphology, and surface properties. The company also emphasizes intelligent production lines and quality management systems (ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in semiconductor packaging materials (EMC, LMC, UF), high-frequency/high-speed copper clad laminates, thermal interface materials, adhesives for photovoltaic and new energy batteries, and advanced insulation products. The company serves downstream industries including 5G communications, AI, high-performance computing, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, aerospace, new energy vehicles, photovoltaic, and environmental protection sectors. Customers are located in China, Japan, South Korea, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Lianyungang, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded sales and cooperation with customers across Japan, South Korea, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan, reflecting a growing international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Novoray operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the development and production of advanced inorganic powder fillers and functional particulate materials that serve as critical raw materials for downstream semiconductor packaging, electronic substrates, adhesives, and thermal management materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, focusing on high-end chip packaging materials, heterogeneous integration advanced packaging, next-generation high-frequency/high-speed substrates, high thermal conductivity interface materials for new energy vehicles, and advanced millimeter-wave radar applications. It pursues innovations in low cut-off point, low alpha, low dielectric loss spherical silicon micro-powders, high-purity spherical alumina powders, and advanced nitride powders. The company collaborates with academic institutions and industry partners, continuously upgrading its technology and expanding product applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of inorganic powder fillers and related functional materials. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by agency sales, with revenues derived from the sale of powders, slurry products, and customized material solutions to industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Novoray is a domestic industry leader with over 40 years of experience and independent intellectual property in inorganic non-metallic powder fillers. It has broken foreign technology monopolies and achieved import substitution, gaining recognition as a national high-tech enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion.' The company holds a strong market position with increasing market share and brand influence, competing with international and domestic peers in advanced semiconductor packaging materials and functional fillers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 711.7 million, a 7.51% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 174 million, a 7.57% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 1.75 billion, up 14.12%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 1.35 billion, up 9.55%. The company increased R&D investment by 23.13% to RMB 47.4 million, representing 6.66% of revenue. The company completed a capital reserve to share capital conversion, increasing total shares by 49%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Novoray emphasizes high-purity, high-filling, high-thermal conductivity, low dielectric loss, and low linear expansion coefficient properties of its spherical inorganic powders, tailored for advanced semiconductor packaging and high-frequency substrates. Its products break foreign technology barriers, offering domestic alternatives with superior performance. The company provides integrated solutions with strong technical support, rapid customer response, and customized product development, aiming to be a trusted partner delivering competitive and innovative functional powder materials globally.
